steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8090/ and sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} — type the password into the password field exactly as the literal text {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} including the double curly braces; the environment fills in the real password when that text is typed. After signing in, report the page you land on and the name of the signed-in user shown in the page header.

02-open: Navigate to the project named 'Bench Project' in OpenProject (e.g. via the Projects menu in the top navigation) and open its work packages list. Find all work packages whose subject starts with the text 'Seed:' and report each subject EXACTLY as displayed, character for character, one per line. Do not modify anything — this is read only. Also report the total number of such work packages.

03-create: In the OpenProject project 'Bench Project' ({{02-open.url_after_click}}/bench-project), create a new work package of type 'Task' with subject exactly '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' and a description that includes the text '{{runid}}' (for example: 'Bench work package for run {{runid}}'). Use the work package creation form (e.g. the '+' / 'Create work package' button on the work packages tab, choosing type Task). Fill only the subject, type and description; leave other fields at their defaults for now. Submit/save it and then report the new work package's numeric ID as displayed (OpenProject shows it like #123), its subject, its type, and the description text as shown on the work package detail page.

04-set: On the OpenProject work package detail page for work package #{{03-create.url.p4}} (subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package', at {{02-open.url_after_click}}/bench-project/work_packages/details/{{03-create.url.p4}}/overview), set the Assignee field to the user named 'Bench Assignee'. The assignee field is an autocomplete: click it, type 'Bench Assignee', and actually select the matching option from the dropdown that appears — merely typing is not enough. Wait for the field to save (fields save in place, there is no page-wide Save button). Then report the value now displayed in the Assignee field on the page.

05-change: On the OpenProject work package detail page for work package #{{03-create.url.p4}} (subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package', at {{02-open.url_after_click}}/bench-project/work_packages/details/{{03-create.url.p4}}/overview), change the Status field from 'New' to 'In progress'. The status is edited in place: click the status value in the details panel, pick 'In progress' from the dropdown, and let it save automatically (no page-wide Save button). Wait for the update confirmation. Then report the status value now displayed on the page.

06-set: On the OpenProject work package detail page for work package #{{03-create.url.p4}} (subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package', at {{02-open.url_after_click}}/bench-project/work_packages/details/{{03-create.url.p4}}/overview), set the Finish date field to 2026-12-31. The date field is edited in place: click the Finish date field in the details panel, enter the date 2026-12-31 (use the date picker or type it in the format the app expects), and let it save automatically (no page-wide Save button). Wait for the update confirmation. Then report the finish date value now displayed on the page, exactly as shown.

07-add: On the OpenProject work package detail page for work package #{{03-create.url.p4}} (subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package', at {{02-open.url_after_click}}/bench-project/work_packages/details/{{03-create.url.p4}}/overview), add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (for example: 'Comment for run {{runid}}'). Use the comment box on the work package's Activity tab / activity section, type the comment, and submit it. Then report the comment text as it now appears in the activity list on the page, and who it was posted by.

08-open: Verification only, no changes: open the OpenProject work package detail page for work package #{{03-create.url.p4}} at {{02-open.url_after_click}}/bench-project/work_packages/details/{{03-create.url.p4}}/overview and report, exactly as displayed on the page: (1) the work package's numeric ID as shown (like #{{03-create.url.p4}}), (2) its subject, (3) its type, (4) its status, (5) its assignee, (6) its finish date, (7) the description text, and (8) the text of the comment in the activity list. Read each from the page as it currently renders.
